ABOUT THIS VEHICLE

Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami is delighted to offer this 2024 Lamborghini Urus Performante for sale!

Engineered to push the limits of what a high-performance SUV can achieve, the Urus Performante combines breathtaking power, motorsport-inspired engineering, and unmistakable Lamborghini design into one extraordinary package. Powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0L V8 producing 657 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque, the Performante accelerates from 0–60 mph in approximately 3.3 seconds while sending power through an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. Its performance-focused chassis sits nearly an inch lower than the standard Urus and replaces the air suspension with steel springs, while extensive carbon fiber components, a wider stance, sharpen its handling and road presence. Inside, the cabin blends premium Alcantara, carbon fiber trim, sport-focused details, and advanced Lamborghini technology, creating an environment that is equally suited to everyday luxury and spirited driving. With its extraordinary ability to deliver sports-car acceleration and remarkable cornering capability from behind the wheel of an SUV, the Urus Performante proves that practicality and performance do not have to be mutually exclusive.

Contact Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami to make this Urus Performante yours today. Sales Price includes dealer fee of $1447.50 and $299 electronic filing fee. Tax, tag, title and registrations fees are not included and are calculated at time of purchase.
